events.text: EUR_AUD: The pair remains in a long-term downward trend with the price sitting below the 200-day moving average (1.634807), and previous desk history on this symbol shows poor results in long mean-reversion and short/fade attempts.

events.name: Elena Castillo
events.text: EUR_AUD: PASS. The desk has a poor historical win rate on forex assets (22% win rate, -0.48 average R) and EUR_AUD specifically, combined with a mixed long-term trend (price below the 200-day SMA) and high macro event risk from the upcoming CPI report. We choose to pass and preserve capital.
